zh: 创世台的影片按尺度因子均匀走，大爆炸最初的几分钟被压成一帧。这里把时间轴换成对数：从普朗克时间到复合，56 个数量级，每十倍时间播同样长。每一帧的粒子成分、温度、反应速率都按量子统计和弱作用实时算出，用的就是创世台上你拨的那组旋钮；汤里闪出来的每一个反应（湮灭、n⇄p、氘、复合）的频率都跟着算出的速率走。
en: The movie on the Forge runs uniformly in the scale factor, so the first minutes of the big bang are squeezed into a single frame. Here the time axis is logarithmic: from the Planck time to recombination, 56 orders of magnitude, every factor of ten in time played for the same length. The particle content, temperature and reaction rates of every frame are computed live from quantum statistics and the weak interaction, using the very set of knobs you turned on the Forge; the frequency of every reaction flashing in the soup (annihilation, n⇄p, deuterium, recombination) follows the computed rate.

en: ▶ Slow play

en: ⏭ Next event

en: per decade of time

en: 3 s

zh: 粒子汤 模拟 每种粒子的点数 ∝ 它占的能量份额；非相对论性的核子另画
en: Particle soup simulated the number of dots of each species ∝ its share of the energy; non-relativistic nucleons are drawn separately

zh: 这一刻在发生什么
en: What is happening right now

zh: 声波：一个原初涨落怎样长成声学视界 模拟 壳的半径 $r_s = \int c_s\,dt/a$ 按当前参数实时积分；剖面形状示意
en: Sound waves: how one primordial fluctuation grows into the acoustic horizon simulated the shell radius $r_s = \int c_s\,dt/a$ is integrated live from the current parameters; the profile shape is schematic

zh: 有效自由度 $g_*(T)$ 量子统计
en: Effective degrees of freedom $g_*(T)$ quantum statistics

zh: 每当温度降到某种粒子的质量 $m_i$ 以下（$T \lesssim m_i$），它就湮灭、把熵交给剩下的粒子：台阶处光子被加热。
en: Whenever the temperature drops below the mass $m_i$ of some particle ($T \lesssim m_i$), it annihilates and hands its entropy to the remaining particles: at each step the photons are heated.

zh: 中子份额 $X_n(t)$ 弱作用 + 氘瓶颈
en: Neutron fraction $X_n(t)$ weak interaction + deuterium bottleneck

zh: 电离度 $x_e(z)$ Saha 平衡
en: Ionization fraction $x_e(z)$ Saha equilibrium

zh: 读完你自己的发现之后再看：量子效应分别在哪一刻起作用
en: Read after you have made your own discoveries: the moment at which each quantum effect acts

zh: 暴胀（$10^{-37}$ 秒）：德西特空间有温度 $T = \hbar H/2\pi k_B$，暴胀子每个哈勃时间长出 $\delta\phi = H/2\pi$ 的量子涨落，被膨胀拉出视界后冻结成经典的密度扰动。$A_s$ 就是这些涨落的功率；它越大，星系的种子越壮。
en: Inflation ($10^{-37}$ s): de Sitter space has a temperature $T = \hbar H/2\pi k_B$; every Hubble time the inflaton grows a quantum fluctuation $\delta\phi = H/2\pi$, which is stretched outside the horizon by the expansion and freezes into a classical density perturbation. $A_s$ is the power of these fluctuations; the larger it is, the stronger the seeds of galaxies.

zh: 粒子汤（$10^{-11}$ 秒到 1 秒）：每种粒子按玻色–爱因斯坦或费米–狄拉克分布占据相空间，$\rho_i = \frac{g_i}{2\pi^2}\int \frac{E\,p^2\,dp}{e^{E/T}\pm1}$；温度降到它的质量以下时它和反粒子湮灭成光子。$g_*(T)$ 的每一级台阶都是一次湮灭。
en: Particle soup ($10^{-11}$ s to 1 s): each species fills phase space according to the Bose–Einstein or Fermi–Dirac distribution, $\rho_i = \frac{g_i}{2\pi^2}\int \frac{E\,p^2\,dp}{e^{E/T}\pm1}$; once the temperature drops below its mass it annihilates with its antiparticle into photons. Every step of $g_*(T)$ is one annihilation.

zh: 中微子退耦（1 秒）：弱作用率 $\propto G_F^2T^5$ 追不上膨胀率 $\propto T^2/M_{Pl}$。此后中微子自己冷却；e⁺e⁻ 湮灭只加热光子，所以今天 $T_\nu/T_\gamma = (4/11)^{1/3}$。
en: Neutrino decoupling (1 s): the weak rate $\propto G_F^2T^5$ can no longer keep up with the expansion rate $\propto T^2/M_{Pl}$. From then on the neutrinos cool on their own; e⁺e⁻ annihilation heats only the photons, which is why today $T_\nu/T_\gamma = (4/11)^{1/3}$.

zh: 中子冻结与核合成（1 秒到 4 分钟）：n/p 在平衡时是 $e^{-Q/T}$，弱作用一慢下来就冻住，然后中子按寿命 $\tau_n$ 衰变。氘的结合能只有 2.2 MeV 而光子有十亿倍之多，要等到 $T\approx0.07$ MeV 氘才能存活（氘瓶颈），这时几乎所有剩下的中子都进了 ⁴He：$Y_p = 2X_n$。$Q$、$\tau_n$、$G_F$、$N_{\mathrm{eff}}$、$\eta$ 每一个都在这里留下指纹。
en: Neutron freeze-out and nucleosynthesis (1 s to 4 min): in equilibrium n/p is $e^{-Q/T}$; as soon as the weak interaction slows down it freezes, and then the neutrons decay with lifetime $\tau_n$. The binding energy of deuterium is only 2.2 MeV while photons outnumber baryons a billion to one, so deuterium cannot survive until $T\approx0.07$ MeV (the deuterium bottleneck), by which time almost all remaining neutrons go into ⁴He: $Y_p = 2X_n$. $Q$, $\tau_n$, $G_F$, $N_{\mathrm{eff}}$ and $\eta$ each leave a fingerprint here.

zh: 复合（38 万年）：氢的电离能 $13.6\,\mathrm{eV} = \alpha^2 m_e c^2/2$，但每个重子配十亿个光子，高能尾巴一直把氢打碎，复合要等到 $T\approx0.26$ eV。电子一旦被束缚，汤姆孙散射率 $\propto\alpha^2/m_e^2$ 掉到膨胀率以下，光子自由飞行：这就是 CMB。
en: Recombination (380,000 years): hydrogen's ionization energy is $13.6\,\mathrm{eV} = \alpha^2 m_e c^2/2$, but with a billion photons per baryon the high-energy tail keeps breaking hydrogen apart, and recombination has to wait until $T\approx0.26$ eV. Once the electrons are bound, the Thomson scattering rate $\propto\alpha^2/m_e^2$ drops below the expansion rate and the photons fly freely: that is the CMB.

zh: 标签：$g_*(T)$、时间、n/p 是按方程算的（模拟）；氦丰度的氘瓶颈阈值按标准模型校准了一个数（$Y_p = 0.247$），氘丰度是经验标度律（拟合）；复合用 Saha 平衡近似，比完整计算早约 4%。
en: Labels: $g_*(T)$, time and n/p are computed from the equations (simulated); the deuterium-bottleneck threshold for the helium abundance is calibrated with one number to the standard model ($Y_p = 0.247$), and the deuterium abundance is an empirical scaling law (fit); recombination uses the Saha-equilibrium approximation, about 4% earlier than the full calculation.
